test_title: SSC Selection Post 2025 (Graduate Level) Official Paper (Held On: 24 Jul, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Which of the following statements best describes 'The Adventures of Padma and a Blue Dinosaur' by Vaishali Shroff?

options.text: Imaginative children's book blending fantasy and science
Historical novel on India's prehistoric era

solution:
The correct answer is __**Imaginative children's book blending fantasy and science**__.
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**
 

__ 
 
• **'The Adventures of Padma and a Blue Dinosaur'** is an engaging children's book authored by **Vaishali Shroff**. It seamlessly combines **elements of fantasy and scientific facts**, making it an imaginative and educational read for children. 
 
• The book explores the theme of **prehistoric life and dinosaurs**, sparking curiosity among young readers about Earth's ancient history while presenting these concepts in a fun and accessible way. 
 
• The storyline is designed to inspire children to explore **scientific topics** such as paleontology, fossils, and Earth's history, while keeping them entertained through a blend of adventure and fantasy. 
 
• Vaishali Shroff's narrative style aims to **stimulate young imaginations** while subtly educating readers on topics related to Earth's past, ancient creatures, and the importance of science in understanding our world. 
 
• Unlike textbooks or purely scientific works, this book **bridges the gap** between entertainment and education, making it ideal for **early readers and young minds**. 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
 

__ 
 
• **Vaishali Shroff**: 
 
• She is an **Indian author** known for her work in children's literature, which often incorporates elements of **science, culture, and history**. 
 
• Her works aim to **engage young readers** by making complex topics relatable and fun through storytelling. 
 
 
 
• **Theme of the Book:** 
 
• It creatively introduces children to the **concept of dinosaurs** and prehistoric times while emphasizing the importance of **scientific exploration**. 
 
• The fantasy elements make the learning experience **enjoyable and interactive**. 
 
 
 
• **Target Audience:** 
 
• The book is primarily targeted at **children aged 7-12 years**, fostering both their imagination and interest in **science and history**. 
 
• It is also suitable for parents and educators looking to introduce **scientific concepts** in a fun and engaging way. 
 
 
 
• **Distinctiveness of the Book:** 
 
• Unlike a **scientific textbook**, the book does not focus solely on factual information but combines it with **storytelling** to make learning enjoyable. 
 
• It avoids being a **historical novel** and instead uses an **imaginative narrative** to explore prehistoric themes. 
 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**
 

 
 
• **Option 2: Historical novel on India's prehistoric era**: This is incorrect as the book is not a historical novel but rather a **blend of fiction and science**. 
 
• **Option 3: Scientific textbook on paleontology**: This is incorrect because the book does not serve as a **formal scientific textbook** but uses storytelling to introduce paleontology. 
 
• **Option 4: Memoir on dinosaur fossil digs**: This is incorrect as the book is not a **memoir**, nor does it recount personal experiences of fossil digs.
